title: PINK1‑regulated mitophagy dysfunction in the pathogenesis of Parkinson's disease (Review).
snippet: Parkinson's disease (PD) is the second most common neurodegenerative disorder, characterized by the progressive loss of dopaminergic neurons in the substantia nigra and the accumulation of misfolded α‑synuclein forming Lewy bodies.
